name: Wei
source:
She grew up as the daughter of the head of the Dark Tiger.
She used to stay in Hong Kong and attend Yen's dance classes, and she sometimes invited Yen to visit her in Macau after she returned to Macau.
She and Yen were kidnapped by the Raksasa Party in a plot by Wong Po to have the Dark Tiger taken over by his younger brother, Dark Cloud.
However, thanks to Lai and Yvet, she is freed and becomes the head of the Dark Tiger.
She helped Yvet by planting a virus on the smartphone of Sammi, whom he had met through dance classes.
